StockRotationExecution.name: StockRotationExecution
StockRotationExecution.description: Represents a stock rotation rebate activity, recording affected inventory and partner information for rebate claim processing.

Account.description: Specifies the partner account participating in the stock rotation execution.

EligibleAmount.description: Specifies the total amount the partner is eligible to claim under the stock rotation program.

EndDate.description: Specifies the end date of the stock rotation execution.

ExecutionReferenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the stock rotation execution process, such as a data processing engine definition.

ProgramReference.description: Specifies the reference object associated with the stock rotation execution.

RebateProgram.description: Specifies the rebate program associated with the stock rotation program.

StartDate.description: Specifies the start date of the stock rotation execution.

Status.description: Indicates the current status of the stock rotation execution. Possible values: New, In-Progress, Completed, Closed, Canceled.

TotalCalculatedAmount.description: Specifies the total calculated amount for the partner under the stock rotation program.

UsageType.description: Identifies the business process this execution record is used for (e.g., Stock Rotation Rebate, Rebate).
